title: t1d-retraining: a leakage-free longitudinal protocol to evaluate when and how to update personalized glucose forecasters
description: Code of a longitudinal evaluation of when and how to update personalized glucose forecasters in type 1 diabetes: a leakage-free day-by-day simulator, staged screening of refit policies and update mechanisms, confirmation under pre-specified rules in several public datasets, and the analyses and figures of the companion articles. No patient data are included; the datasets are requested from their sources.
